title: Arts-district renovations, Gateway stacks, and why PG summers sweat at older trunks
headline: Arts-district renovations, Gateway stacks, and why PG summers sweat at older trunks
description: Hyattsville, MD sits on the Route 1 spine in Prince George’s County. why older ducts collect humidity and corridor grit.

sections.heading: Route 1 is the arts district. It is also a dust corridor.
paragraphs: The arts district and Gateway, West Hyattsville, then streets toward College Park mix early brick, later rentals, and new stacked units over older mechanical rooms. Route 1 construction and traffic add grit the returns do not sort from pollen. Prince George’s summers are wet. Cool trunks in a basement or crawl sweat.
Arts-district renovations kick drywall into shared chases. The first AC week after a humid spell is when registers gray out and the laundry smells like a packed dryer vent.

sections.heading: New stacked units still sit on old moisture
paragraphs: A renovated Gateway building can have a new kitchen over a mechanical room that never got cleaned. Shared dryer chases pack lint. Humidity from Route 1 rain weeks sits on cool metal. Tenants wipe registers. The film comes back.
If dust returns days after a make-ready, when you are ready to book, use the [Hyattsville, MD location page](/locations/hyattsville).

sections.heading: Typical signs in a Hyattsville house or unit
listItems: Gray film on supplies after Route 1 construction weeks.
Musty air from a basement or crawl when the AC starts after rain.
Two-cycle dry times in a stacked arts-district or Gateway unit.

listItems: Clean ducts after a renovation, not five years later.
Keep basement humidity under 50% in summer.
Clear stacked dryer vents about once a year or at turnover.

faq.q: Does construction near Hyattsville change cleaning intervals?
faq.a: Active drywall work nearby often shortens the useful interval. Wait until heavy dust settles, then inspect.

faq.q: Should I clean ducts after renovations?
faq.a: Yes if sanding or drywall dust entered returns. Otherwise a standard 3–5 year interval is typical.

faq.q: What proof should a cleaning include?
faq.a: Before-and-after photos of trunks or vents, plus a clear scope agreed before work starts.
